description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Front door of Atlas. With no actor_token you are outside. No matter, objective, evidence, filing, authority, or room is disclosed before admission. Authentication and enrollment grant nothing. Enrollment does not verify a principal and does not admit you.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.
